item.title: Ridiculous amount of bikes, 4th November
item.description:
An absolutely insane amount of bikes is now being left on Boss Street. This started as people parking their bikes there at the end of a journey, but this must now be the likes of Voi and Lime bike dropping off an absolutely ridiculous amount of bikes in this area. As you’ll see from this photo Voi have dropped off far more bikes than should be allowed in this area. There has to be a limit on the number of bikes for this area. It blocks paths constantly and uses up street parking spaces, as well as creating a disturbing amount of noise - we live here and are constantly disturbed by people picking up and dropping off bikes and using the bells - so disturbing and unfair.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 2, Boss Street, Old Kent Road, Greater London
